description: Update an existing pump.fun alert rule by id on the authenticated three.ws account. Partial — only the fields you pass change. Idempotent: re-applying the same values yields the same rule. Common uses: flip `enabled` to pause/resume, retune `threshold`, add or swap a delivery channel, or change `kind` (the rule is re-validated against the new kind, and fields incompatible with it are cleared automatically). Pass null to clear a clearable field (target_mint, target_agent, threshold, webhook_url, telegram_chat, label). Removing webhook_url drops its secret; adding one mints a fresh webhook_secret (returned). The result must still have at least one delivery channel and satisfy the kind's targeting/threshold rules, or the API rejects it with a precise message. Returns the updated rule. Requires THREE_WS_SESSION.

kind.description: Change the event kind. The rule is re-validated against it and incompatible fields are cleared.

label.description: Human label, or null to fall back to the derived default.

rule_id.description: Id of the rule to update (from list_alert_rules).

target_agent.description: three.ws agent UUID to watch, or null to clear. Required by new_mint; forbidden for mint-targeted kinds.

target_mint.description: Coin mint to watch, or null to clear. Required by price/whale kinds; forbidden for new_mint.

telegram_chat.description: Telegram numeric chat id or @username, or null to remove.

threshold.description: USD market cap (price kinds) or SOL buy size (whale_buy), or null to clear.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS endpoint for signed alert events, or null to remove the webhook (and its secret).

name: update_alert_rule
title: Update a pump.fun alert rule
